name: Amagi Touya
source:
A descendant of the Amagi family, who was said to be the head of Youkai Extermination Shops. 

He doesn't have much of the spiritual power that is essential for an extermination shop, and the swordsmanship he's trained since he was a child is far from being as good as Kikou. However, his boldness, passion, and recklessness are second to none... maybe.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/react-kikou-4]official website[/url]]
